race.comment: TROUBLE'N PARADISE (2) resumes. He showed ability early last campaign and should be an improver this time around. He'll kick up and take some catching. CLASSIC SECRET (12) ran a good race behind a very good filly on debut at Geelong to grab third. Better for that and should get a nice run midfield. RUN RUN WIN (11) can run well on debut for the Price & Kent Jnr yard. Gelding by Wild Ruler who profiles well for this being a son of the stakes-winning mare Make My Own Luck. KING KORUNA (6) should be poised to run a big race first up from a spell following two recent trials - must be respected. LUCKY GENERAL (7) is worth a market watch on debut.
